scope: Three full-body HARD concepts derived solely from NORMAL Justitia identity. Comparison candidates, not selected/fixed.

references.role: sole initial image input; normal Justitia character identity, body proportions, face, hairstyle, blindfold, costume, sword, back scale and clean rendering
single framing correction edit target; no design changes requested

visual_qa.identity: Normal blindfolded pale face and side-swept sculpted ivory curls retained. Slender feminine torso, narrow waist, long slim legs, high navy collar, formal ivory/navy/gold robe and star fastenings remain recognizable.
visual_qa.hard_transformation: Strongly tilted expanded articulated rear beam, heavy single judicial weight inside lower pan, higher empty pan, sharpened enlarged ceremonial robe tails and restrained lavender shell stress cracks.
visual_qa.anatomy_and_props: Exactly two arms and two legs; two delicate hands grasp one original broad down-pointing sword. One back scale beam and exactly two chain-hung pans, one loaded and one empty.
visual_qa.framing: Final 1536x1024 landscape. One full-body hero. Both beam ends, hair, chains, pans, sword point/hilt, hands, robe hems and both feet contained. Approximately 90 px top and 100 px bottom clearance; wide lateral clearance.
visual_qa.style: Clean polished 2D game concept, smooth ivory/navy/brass, lavender cel shadows, fine lines, quiet pale lavender backdrop; no text, sheet views, collage, rust, gore or PBR.
visual_qa.correction: One targeted framing correction after initial image clipped the upper beam tip and had tight lower clearance; final design retained.

images.description_ko: 기울어진 대형 저울과 무거운 추. 넓어진 예복과 균열로 판결의 무게를 강조.

references.role: sole initial identity reference and edit target

visual_qa.identity: Same sculpted wavy ivory hairstyle, gold-edged blindfold and calm visible lower face; normal-size head; narrow waist and slender long limbs; tall navy collar and ivory/navy/gold star-accented ceremonial robe retained.
visual_qa.hard_changes: Two modestly opened ivory chest panels expose a narrow brass spindle with restrained lavender light. Sharpened separated robe panels enlarge silhouette; rear beam has strained offset joints and exactly two unequal-height pans.
visual_qa.anatomy_equipment: Exactly two arms, two legs, delicate hands, two feet, one broad greatsword and two chain-hung scale pans. No extra limbs, giant torso or hollow ring cavity.
visual_qa.framing: 1536x1024 landscape, one full-body character. Hair top approximately y=89; bottommost sword point approximately y=883. Beam tips, both pans, weapon and feet fully enclosed with comfortable margins.
visual_qa.style: Clean polished 2D concept with ivory/navy/brass palette, lavender cel shadows and pale quiet backdrop. No text, inset, source sheet, gore, rust or photorealistic texture.
visual_qa.correction: One targeted framing correction only; entire assembled subject reduced while design identity was preserved.

images.description_ko: 노멀에 가까운 자세. 갈라진 흉부 외피 사이로 가는 시계축이 드러나는 변형.

references.role: sole initial identity/style reference; normal face, wavy hair, blindfold, slender proportions, robe, sword and scale apparatus

visual_qa.identity: Wavy ivory hair, gold-edged blindfold, calm pale lower face, slender waist and long legs, navy high collar, star robe and original sword retained.
visual_qa.hard_changes: One-sided hinged shell exposes a slender dark inner frame. Taut back-mast chains connect to real elbow and hip sockets. Asymmetric segmented formal robe, tilted scale and one weighted pan.
visual_qa.anatomy_equipment: Exactly two arms, two legs, one head, one sword, one back mast/beam and exactly two pans. No bulk increase or new monster anatomy.
visual_qa.framing: Entire full-body silhouette, beam, both pans, sword and robe held within ample margins, approximately 110px top and 150px bottom.
visual_qa.style: Polished 2D cel concept with ivory/navy/gold and lavender, fine controlled lines and pale quiet backdrop, no text or insets.
visual_qa.correction: One framing-only correction reduced complete subject, preserved the design.

images.description_ko: 한쪽 외피의 분절과 구속 사슬. 비대칭 예복으로 긴장감을 만든 변형.

independent_review.checked: Original NORMAL and all three final images
independent_review.findings: All preserve normal identity and valid full-body construction. C offers the strongest balance of source identity and cursed HARD transformation; A has the strongest enlarged silhouette; B is most conservative.
independent_review.gallery: Local HTML rendered and visually inspected; all four image paths present; JavaScript syntax checked.
